name: DataWarrior
description: DataWarrior’s updater compares update JARs with MD5 values supplied by its metadata. Its plugin channel is separate; these observations do not establish independent publisher authentication or every automatic-update setting.
limitations: New default-branch snapshot rather than the original study checkout; the server response and release process were not independently verified, and the source does not show an independent signature or pinned-key control in this path.
